chapter.heading: A song for pilgrims ascending to Jerusalem.
chapter.v:
I lift
my eyes to you, O God, enthroned in heaven.

We keep
looking to the Lord our God for his mercy,just as servants keep their eyes on their master,as a slave girl watches her mistress for the slightest signal.

Have mercy
on us, Lord, have mercy,for we have had our fill of contempt.

We have
had more than our fill of the scoffing of the proudand the contempt of the arrogant.
